lines.t: [Mary Mary Style]
Yeah—uh, I was bound, now I’m free, uh!
All glory to the King of kings!
Come on, come on, yeah—let’s praise Him!
I used to walk in shadow, hearing only my pain,
Chasing after whispers that led me to the rain.
But then Your truth came shining, cutting through the lie,
Now I’m dancing in Your mercy, got my eyes on high!
It’s the Word that heals, it’s the fire that saves,
It’s the Spirit of power that rolls the stone away!
Now I lift my hands up, praise You, Lord! (Praise You, Lord!)
You broke my chains and opened every door! (Every door!)
Now I’m walking in the light, and there’s freedom in my soul,
You spoke a word of truth—and made me whole!
The trumpets of heaven, yeah, they call my name,
Every step is guided by the Lamb who was slain.
No more fear, no more shame inside,
I’m clothed in truth, with glory as my guide!
It’s the voice of love, it’s the sound of grace,
Calls the children home to the holy place!
Now I lift my hands up, praise You, Lord! (Praise You, Lord!)
You broke my chains and opened every door! (Every door!)
Now I’m walking in the light, and there’s freedom in my soul,
You spoke a word of truth—and made me whole!
When the world says no, You whisper “come!”,
When my strength ran out, You were the One!
Now my heart beats loud with Heaven’s sound,
Your volumes of truth, they turned me around!
Ayy, I’m free—free in the Name!
Lift Him up, proclaim His reign!
Spirit fire, burning bright,
I’m living in the truth, walking in light!
Now I lift my hands up, praise You, Lord! (Praise You, Lord!)
You broke my chains and opened every door! (Every door!)
Now I’m walking in the light, and there’s freedom in my soul,
You spoke a word of truth—and made me whole!
Yeah, I’m alive in the truth that reigns—
Praise You, Lord, forevermore!
All glory to the Kingdom’s shore!
